effects.name: Rainbow
effects.code:
param speed = 0.5 [0, 2]
r, g, b = hsv(t * speed + u, 1, 1)

effects.name: Chase
effects.code:
param speed = 0.5 [0, 4]
pos = fract(t * speed)
d = abs(fract(u - pos + 0.5) - 0.5)
k = smoothstep(0.1, 0, d)
r = k
g = k
b = k

effects.name: Sparkle
effects.code:
param speed = 1 [0, 4]
sp = noise(u * 40 + t * speed * 3)
k = smoothstep(0.6, 0.9, sp)
r = k
g = k * 0.8
b = k * 0.5

triggers.name: == SHOW
triggers.notes: Section 3 of PHAROS-COMPARISON-PLAN.md. Build the same on the LPC. Everything listens on UDP port 4000.

triggers.name: UDP FADEUP: Off to Full in 10 s (S3)
UDP FADEDOWN: Full to Off in 10 s
UDP PING: answer PONG (S7)
triggers.notes: For the round trip (T5): "PING 17" comes back as "PONG 17".

triggers.name: Contact in0: snap to Full (S9)
triggers.notes: Machine Control input 0. Only if the LPC has a contact wired too.

triggers.name: UDP REL2: everything released in 2 s
triggers.notes: For tools/lpc/compare.js --udp: the same as the LPC test project's "off" trigger (UDP in, the light starts to move).

triggers.name: UDP FX3: + sparkle on top (T8)
actions: fire trigger "UDP FX2: + chase on top (T8)"

triggers.name: UDP HOUR: start the 1 hour timeline (S5)
Clock: UDP to the PC at 12:00:00 (T7)
triggers.notes: Change the time to a few minutes from now; the capture shows how far off the real time it came.

triggers.name: == FOR tools/stress/stress.js
triggers.notes: The same names as the stress show, so "echo" and "udpin" of stress.js run on this show too. Ten counters: one trigger fires at most 100 times a second.
